compare.how: “Usual variation” uses each shot’s margin of error (or the spread within a group) at {n} % confidence.

note.club_mismatch: Different clubs ({a} vs {b}): speed and distance are not comparable
note.mixed_clubs: A group mixes clubs: its average means little
note.mixed_presets: A group mixes shots from different camera setups
note.mixed_views: A group mixes camera angles: its average means little

note.other: Something about this comparison needs care

note.view_mismatch: Different camera angles ({a} vs {b}): they measure different numbers

compare.nothing: No number was measured on both sides
compare.same_setup: Same camera setup: a fair comparison

ANALYSIS_TIMEOUT: Analysis took too long and was stopped
ANALYSIS_TIMEOUT.fix: Try again, or trim the video.

ASSEMBLE_FAILED: Something went wrong while putting the results together

BACKEND: Data on this phone cannot be accessed

BAD_MESSAGE: Something went wrong inside the app

error.BAD_QUERY: The search could not be run
error.BAD_RECORD: The data is not in the expected format

CAMERA_BUSY: Another app is using the camera
CAMERA_BUSY.fix: Close the other app using the camera, then tap Try again.

CAMERA_DENIED.fix: Go to Settings › Safari › Camera, choose Allow, then tap Try again.

DECODE_FAILED: The video could not be decoded
DECODE_FAILED.fix: In Photos use Save to Files, then import it from Files.

DEMUX_FAILED: This video file cannot be read
DEMUX_FAILED.fix: Choose an original MP4 or MOV from the phone camera.

FILE_TRUNCATED.fix: Wait until the video has fully downloaded or copied, then import it.

error.GPU_UNAVAILABLE: The GPU is not available; using the CPU (slower)

INIT_FAILED: The analysis engine could not start

INTERNAL.fix: Try again. If it keeps happening, copy the report in Settings › Diagnostics.

MODEL_LOAD_FAILED: The pose model could not load
MODEL_LOAD_FAILED.fix: Open the app once while online so all offline files download.

MODULE_MISSING: This version does not include this feature

NOT_INITIALIZED: The analysis engine is still starting
NOT_INITIALIZED.fix: Wait a few seconds and try again.

error.NO_DOCUMENT: Compatibility mode only runs in the main window

NO_MEDIA_DEVICES: This browser cannot use the camera

NO_SWING_FOUND: No complete swing was found in the video
NO_SWING_FOUND.fix: Make sure the video shows the whole swing from address to finish.

NO_VIDEO_TRACK: The file has no video in it

NO_WAKE_LOCK: The screen cannot be kept on
NO_WAKE_LOCK.fix: Set Auto-Lock to a longer time.

OUT_OF_MEMORY.fix: Close other apps or trim the video, then try again.

POSE_FAILED: Your body position could not be found
POSE_FAILED.fix: Keep your whole body in frame, in good light.

QUOTA_EXCEEDED: The phone is out of storage space
QUOTA_EXCEEDED.fix: Free up space in Settings › Storage.

error.UNSUPPORTED: This device does not support this feature

UNSUPPORTED_CODEC: This device cannot decode this video format
UNSUPPORTED_CODEC.fix: Set the camera format to Most Compatible (H.264) and record again.

VERSION_NEWER: The data comes from a newer version of the app

WASM_LOAD_FAILED: The analysis engine could not load
WASM_LOAD_FAILED.fix: Open the app once while online so all offline files download.

error.WEBCODECS_UNAVAILABLE: This device decodes in compatibility mode (slower)

WORKER_CRASHED: The analysis engine stopped responding and was restarted

WORKER_UNAVAILABLE: The analysis engine is not available

guide.step1: Open the slow-motion video in Photos.

guide.why_body: Picking straight from Photos compresses the video and lowers its frame rate, so ball numbers cannot be measured. Saving to Files keeps the original 240 fps.

perm.body: Tap “Allow” once and the phone asks for each one. You can still use the app if you say no, with fewer features.

perm.camera_why: Films your swing. Without it you can only import videos.

perm.microphone_fix_unsupported: No microphone: swings are detected from motion only.
perm.microphone_why: Hears the strike, to tell real swings from practice swings.
perm.motion_fix_busy: The level is not available right now; try again later.
perm.motion_fix_denied: That is fine: line up with the on-screen frame during setup.
perm.motion_fix_unsupported: This device has no level sensor: line up with the on-screen frame instead.
perm.motion_why: Works as a spirit level to get the phone straight.
perm.result_camera_off: The camera is off: you can still import slow-motion videos.

welcome.body: Put your phone on a tripod and every swing gets measured: tempo, body motion and club speed.

welcome.p3: Everything stays on this phone: no upload, no account

level.roll_neg: The phone tilts left: turn it a little to the right
level.roll_pos: The phone tilts right: turn it a little to the left
level.still_off: The level is still off: the angle comes from the mat
level.title: Level the phone

mic_off.body: The strike cannot be heard: swings are detected from motion, so a practice swing may count as a shot.
mic_off.title: Microphone is off

picker.canvas: Mat picture: tap the four corners

sun.body: Switch to the Sun display: high contrast and bolder text, easier to read outdoors.
sun.title: Bright sun?

tripod.body: Place the tripod as shown, lens pointing at the ball. The numbers are worked out for this venue.
tripod.diagram: Top-down view of the tripod position, {view}
tripod.height_hint: From the mat to the centre of the lens
tripod.no_bay: No bay depth measured: using the standard distance. Add the bay depth to the venue for better numbers.
tripod.title: Put the tripod here

view.changed: Switched to {view}: phone {orient}, set up again from step 1
view.label: Camera angle

correction.nothing: Move a phase first to save

shot.correction_saved_tempo: Correction saved (no pose data for this shot: only tempo recalculated)

glossary.ci_note: “±” is the margin of error: the true value is inside it 95 % of the time.

leave.body: You moved swing phases but did not save them. They will be lost.
leave.title: Leave without saving?

load_failed.body: Try again. If it keeps happening, copy the report in Settings › Diagnostics.
load_failed.title: Could not open this shot

revision.restore_body: Your corrections stay in the record; the numbers are recalculated from the original phases.

share.title: A shot from Golf Swing Lab

unmeasured.not_computed: Not worked out for this shot

summary.one: {n} number not measured on this shot
summary.other: {n} numbers not measured on this shot

unmeasured.tip_dtl: To measure these, film the next shot from behind, along the target line.
unmeasured.tip_face_on: To measure these, film the next shot face-on.

storage.low_free: Less than {minMb} MB free ({freeMb} MB left). Consider not keeping videos for now.

over_limit.one: Storage is over the limit ({usedMb} MB used). Export a backup first. Clean-up only deletes raw videos (oldest unstarred first), never a shot’s numbers or pose: {n} video can go, about {freedMb} MB.
over_limit.other: Storage is over the limit ({usedMb} MB used). Export a backup first. Clean-up only deletes raw videos (oldest unstarred first), never a shot’s numbers or pose: {n} videos can go, about {freedMb} MB.

storage.over_limit_practice: Storage is over the limit ({usedMb} MB used). During practice this is only a warning; nothing is deleted.

over_limit_unsatisfied.one: Storage is over the limit ({usedMb} MB used). Deleting every video that can go ({n} video, about {freedMb} MB) is still not enough: export, then free space by hand.
over_limit_unsatisfied.other: Storage is over the limit ({usedMb} MB used). Deleting every video that can go ({n} videos, about {freedMb} MB) is still not enough: export, then free space by hand.

storage.unknown: Storage use can’t be read, so nothing was cleaned up.

ball.body: Measure from the ball spot to the long mat edge on the phone side.
ball.hint: Most ranges are about {v} {unit}; leave it empty if unsure
ball.label: Ball to the phone-side edge
ball.title: Where the ball sits

bay.body: Measure from the ball to the partition or wall in front of you. It tells how far and how high the face-on phone can go, and makes ball numbers more accurate.
bay.hint: The tripod itself takes about 25 cm
bay.label: Ball to the partition in front
bay.skip_hint: You can leave it empty: the standard distance is used.
bay.title: Bay depth (optional)

finish.body: Give it a name. Slope and tee are optional; they make ball numbers more accurate.
finish.title: Last step

flock.body: The first time you set up here, after you tap the mat corners the app measures twice more and remembers the lens; you will not need to do it again.
flock.title: The lens is calibrated during the first setup

length.body: Measure the mat along the target line with a tape, twice. The two readings must agree within {tol}.
length.title: Measure the mat length

delete_body.one: This venue and its {n} camera spot are deleted. Your shots are kept.
delete_body.other: This venue and its {n} camera spots are deleted. Your shots are kept.

list.empty_body: A measured mat makes the ball numbers more accurate.
list.title: Venues

pair.bad: Readings differ by {d}, more than {tol}: measure again
pair.need_second: Measure again and enter the second reading.

reason.bay: That distance is too short; check the unit
reason.edge: The ball must be on the mat
reason.mismatch: The two readings differ too much
reason.range: That does not look like a mat size; check the unit

venue.save_no_repo: This browser cannot store data; the venue was not saved

slope.hint: Lay the phone flat on the mat for 3 seconds to measure the slope.
slope.measuring: Measuring — do not touch the phone…
slope.title: Mat slope (optional)
slope.unavailable: This device cannot measure the slope: enter it by hand

tee.hint: A fixed rubber tee at the range lifts the ball.
tee.title: Tee

width.body: Measure the mat from your side to the phone side, also twice.
width.title: Measure the mat width

dtl.hint: Phone behind you, along the target line

face_on.hint: Phone straight in front of you, facing your chest

high_behind.hint: Phone high behind you; sees the ball start left or right
